{{short description|American statistician}}
'''Barry D. Nussbaum''' is an American statistician. Nussbaum earned a bachelor's degree from [[Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute]] and a master's and doctorate from [[George Washington University]].<ref name=":0" /> 

Nussbaum joined the [[United States Environmental Protection Agency]] in 1975 and served as chief statistician from 2006 to 2016.<ref>[http://magazine.amstat.org/blog/2012/02/01/nussbaum/ Meet EPA Chief Statistician Barry D. Nussbaum]. ''Amstat News''. 1 February 2012.</ref>  Early in his career, Nussbaum helped lead a recall of 208,000 cars for excessive carbon monoxide emissions, based on a sample of just ten cars.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://blog.epa.gov/blog/2010/10/sw-world-statistic-day/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120707004139/http://blog.epa.gov/blog/2010/10/sw-world-statistic-day/|url-status=dead|archive-date=July 7, 2012|title=Science Wednesday: EPA and World Statistics Day|website=blog.epa.gov|language=en-US|access-date=2018-02-19}}</ref>  He is a recipient of two [[Awards and decorations of the United States government#Environmental Protection Agency|EPA Silver Medals for Superior Service]] and the [[Awards and decorations of the United States government#Environmental Protection Agency|EPA's Distinguished Career Service Award]].<ref>[http://ww2.amstat.org/meetings/sdss/2018/featuredspeakers.cfm], SDSS Symposium on Data Science and Statistics: Featured Speakers.</ref><ref>[https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/events/2015nchs/speakers.htm], National Center for Health Statistics: Plenary Speakers.</ref>

Nussbaum was [[List of presidents of the American Statistical Association|president]] of the [[American Statistical Association]] for 2017.<ref name=":0">[http://magazine.amstat.org/blog/2015/07/01/2015electionresults/ EPA’s Barry D. Nussbaum Elected 112th ASA President]. ''Amstat News''. 1 July 2015.</ref>

He has also taught graduate statistics courses for [[Virginia Tech]] and [[George Washington University|George Washington]] universities.<ref name=":0" />

In 2024 Nussbaum was recipient of the [[American Statistical Association Founders Award|American Statistical Association's Founders Award]].<ref name=ASAFoundersAward>{{cite web | title=Founders Award | publisher=American Statistical Association | url=https://www.amstat.org/your-career/awards/founders-award }}</ref>
